_comment: Machine-readable contract for the ledger, provenance grades and statuses. Scripts read this; a new field only needs a new entry in lexicon.json, and a new domain only needs a new family here.

steps.question: can a reader execute the procedure in order?
steps.failure: the reader has to reverse-engineer the pipeline from the parameters alone

setup.question: hardware, software versions, environment, seed, repeat count
setup.checked_by: ledger rows with family runtime or reproducibility
setup.failure: a run that works here may fail or silently change precision elsewhere

params.question: named values with unit, target object and source
params.checked_by: ledger rows with family optim / schedule / model / eval
params.failure: differences between runs cannot be attributed to the method

data.question: dataset name, version, size, preprocessing, split ratio and method
data.failure: the reader cannot tell whether the result comes from the method or the data

baseline.question: baseline object and version, matched budget, metric
baseline.failure: a comparison reads as an assertion instead of a result

limits.question: named gap plus the concrete failure scenario
limits.failure: the reader cannot tell which regime the conclusion does not cover

config.definition: a configuration file that a runner reads: yaml, json, ini, toml

log.definition: output of a run: stdout log, results csv, metrics json

code.definition: source code defaults, argparse defaults, function signatures

manuscript.definition: prose in a paper, README or note: evidence about what was claimed

author_confirmed.definition: a value the author states when asked

other.definition: readable but of no evidential class

none.definition: no source at all; must appear in the gap list

ledger_status.confirmed: 有配置/日志/代码/作者确认作为来源，且无冲突
ledger_status.manuscript_only: 只有论文/README 作为来源
ledger_status.conflicting: 不同文件对同一参数给出不同值，两值并列保留
ledger_status.prose_multi_value: 散文描述多个实例，需作者指出哪个适用

validation_status.warn: no failures, something a reviewer should see
validation_status.incomplete: nothing failed, but at least one check could not run; this is NOT a pass

conflict_rule.same_file_never_conflicts: 一个文件里的不同作用域是作者自己做的区分（train/infer 分节、表格两行），不判冲突
conflict_rule.cross_file_compares_by_name: 跨文件按参数名比较，不看作用域字面：配置的 scope 是分节名，日志的 scope 是行位置，两者永远撞不上
conflict_rule.same_value: 数值按 numbers.py 归一后判等；比例类名字允许 10% 与 0.1 判等
conflict_rule.different_scope: 不同文件之间即使作用域不同也参与比较
conflict_rule.prose_is_one_directional: 硬来源的每个值都必须出现在散文里；散文多提到的实例不算矛盾

locator_convention.forbidden: page numbers are not produced by this tool: no reliable page mapping exists for text-wrapped materials, and an invented page number is exactly the failure this task punishes

draft_format.markdown: plain markdown; headings become sections, blank lines split paragraphs
draft_format.rule: the tool never rewrites the draft; it only maps numbers to sources and reports gaps
